answer: I'm sorry for your loss. To sell a car you inherited, bring the death certificate plus either court letters naming you executor or administrator of the estate, or, for a small estate that doesn't go through probate court, the heir and estate affidavit (form NW-EST-1) signed by the heir; if there are several heirs, the executor signs or every heir signs NW-EST-1. A power of attorney your father signed can't be used, because it ended when he passed away. If there's still a loan on the car, the lender holds the title; if it's paid off and the title is lost, you'll need a duplicate title from your state before we can complete the purchase, though you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait.
